statement: On the OASIS-3 dataset of 696 subjects represented as 170-node networks, the four Table 3 mean matching accuracies are diffusion CDOT 0.6136, diffusion FGW 0.1853, geodesic CDOT 0.4640, and geodesic FGW 0.5375.
route: direct registered Table 3 rerun plus falsification of the exact cohort invariant
quantifier: all 4,950 unordered pairs among the first 100 subjects, alongside the reported 696-subject cohort represented by 170-node Scale-2 networks
acceptance_obligations: download and SHA-256 pin the primary archive named by the data provider
enumerate every archive member, session, and subject
parse the atlas ID of every node in every GraphML
select the lexicographically first 100 subject IDs and each earliest session
run CDOT and FGW for all 4,950 pairs under normalized diffusion and reciprocal-fiber geodesic distance at alpha=0.5 and T=200
reproduce CDOT greater than FGW for diffusion and FGW greater than CDOT for geodesic
independently reconstruct all four means and the exact pair inventory from raw rows
compare the custom FGW solver with POT on fixed pairs
show that a subject included among the full 696 has no 170-node session
reject padding and show that cyclic anatomical misregistration degrades matching accuracy
logical_rule: The full empirical claim is a conjunction. The complete registered first-100 execution directly tests the two Table 3 method orderings, while a primary-data counterexample independently falsifies the explicit 696-by-170 cohort premise. Exact numeric recovery is reported separately from directional recovery.
non_circularity: The archive, all-member enumeration, exact ID set, and 170-node threshold come from the source claim and provider page, not from observed outcomes.
